{{Infobox Character |image= {{Media |Model BotW= File:BotW Darton Model.png |Model TotK= File:TotK Darton Model.png }} |caption= |title= |alias= |race= [[Hylian]] |gender= Male{{Cite|My boys are wellsprings of information about horses, so feel free to pick their brains.|Rensa|BotW}} |game= BotW, TotK |other= |era= [[Era of the Wilds]] |family= {{List| * [[Rensa]] {{Small|(father)}} * [[Tasseren]] {{Small|(uncle)}}{{Cite|If you manage to catch one, let my brother Tasseren know. He'll register the horse for you!|Rensa|BotW}} * [[Shibo]] {{Small|(twin brother)}}{{Cite|You really can tell just by looking into his eyes! Bro, his head is just filled with horse stuff, right?|Darton|BotW}} }} |voiceactor= |theme= |counter= }} {{Term/Store|Darton||Series, BotW, TotK}} is a recurring character in {{TLoZ Series}}.{{Cite|Darton|Game Screen|BotW}}{{Cite|Darton|Game Screen|TotK}} ==Biography== ==={{BotW|-}}=== Darton is a [[Hylian]] child who lives at [[Dueling Peaks Stable]] with his family. During the day, he can be found near the [[Horse]]s with his twin brother, [[Shibo]]. At night, Darton will go inside the [[Stable]] to sleep.{{Cite|{{Small|I'm feeling so sleepy all of a sudden...}}|Darton|BotW}} While asleep, Darton will count one-colored Horses.{{Cite|{{Small|One one-color horsey...
Two one-color horsies...}}|Darton|BotW}} When he wakes up, Darton will attempt to beat Shibo to the Horse pen. According to [[Sagessa]], Darton and Shibo will collect more [[Apple]]s if the Stable runs out.{{Cite|If the {{Color BotW|Blue|apples}} run out, the children will go pick some more. They told me to take as many as I want.|Sagessa|BotW}} When approached, he begins speaking to his brother in hushed words about whether or not [[Link]] may be interested in Horses.{{Cite|{{Small|Hey, Shibo... You think this nosy guy right here is interested in horses?}}|Darton|BotW}} He decides that Link has the look of a Horse enthusiast,{{Cite|{{Small|You're right. He's got eyes that just say, like... "Nothing in this world matters to me except horses."}}|Darton|BotW}} and concludes that he must be a customer.{{Cite|{{Small|THAT MEANS...}}|Darton|BotW}}{{Cite|That means we've got ourselves a customer!|Darton|BotW}} Darton believes that Link's passion for Horses is apparent in his eyes. Because of this, Darton encourages Link to ask the pair of them for information about steeds.{{Cite|In that case, you should feel free to ask us anything at all about horses!|Darton|BotW}} Darton and Shibo will tell Link various facts about Horses if he asks. They will teach him how to sneak up behind a Horse to catch it off guard,{{Cite|[Catching a horse...] Wild horses get scared easily, and if they notice people near them, they'll take off. Just sneak up on 'em from behind real slow. When you get good and close...grab 'em and jump on quick!|Shibo|BotW}} essentially teaching him how to crouch.{{Cite|If you crouch and sneak up quietly...they won't notice you!|Darton|BotW}} If questioned about which Horses are good for riding, they will explain how the color indicates their temperament: gentle Horses have spots, while more wild Horses are solid in color.{{Cite|[Good horses?] Horses with {{Color BotW|Blue|spots}} on them are even-tempered and easy to train. On the other hand, horses that are all {{Color BotW|Blue|one color}}, like straight black or white, are a bit more wild and harder to train.|Shibo|BotW}} They also point out the differences between the two temperaments.{{Cite|But a {{Color BotW|Blue|one-color}} horse has more stamina and runs faster, right?|Darton|BotW}} Darton and Shibo's father, [[Rensa]], also gave them advice on what kind of Horse is difficult to train, and which to start with.{{Cite|Dad said they're hard to handle at first, but if you spend a lot of time with a {{Color BotW|Blue|one-color}} horse, you'll be best buds!|Shibo|BotW}}{{Cite|Dad also said that beginners should start with {{Color BotW|Blue|spotted}} horses... When I grow up, I'll ride a {{Color BotW|Blue|one-color}} horse, though!|Shibo|BotW}} When asked about how to train a Horse properly, the twins point out that a Horse will not be obedient at first and must be soothed.{{Cite|They're really wild, so they'll run in different directions and buck here and there because they aren't trained yet. When that happens, you've gotta soothe them!|Shibo|BotW}} Darton mentions that their father says constantly soothing a Horse will not help,{{Cite|But dad also said that just constantly soothing them won't do at all.|Darton|BotW}} so the rider must only do it when the Horse is doing what it is being told.{{Cite|The trick is to soothe them when they do what you want them to do. It's like saying "thanks" to them for a job well done!|Shibo|BotW}} Whenever the twins are finished answering a question, Darton will ask if Link understood everything.{{Cite|Hey, mister! Ya get all that?|Darton|BotW}} When Link decides to leave, Darton and Shibo will say goodbye the same way.{{Cite|See ya! Bye-bye! Take care, now!|Shibo|BotW}} Speaking to Darton again, he will refer to Link as the "twinless dude".{{Cite|Look, Shibo, it's the twinless dude!|Darton|BotW}} ==={{TotK|-}}=== Darton and his brother [[Shibo]] can be seen outside of [[Dueling Peaks Stable]]. ==Nomenclature== {{Nomenclature}} ==See Also== {{See Also| * Hylian * Dueling Peaks Stable * Rensa * Shibo * Stable Worker * Tasseren }} {{Ref}} {{Categories |Hylians, Hyruleans, Stable Workers |characters= BotW, TotK }}
